description: Helper script for updating test error expectations based on actual test results, specifically for parsing gtest failure outputs and updating corresponding PEM error files.

methods.name: read_file_to_string
methods.description: Reads a file entirely into a string.

methods.name: write_string_to_file
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.

methods.name: replace_string
methods.description: Replaces a specified range in the original string with a replacement string.

methods.name: fixup_pem_file
methods.description: Updates the ERRORS block in a PEM file with new error data.

methods.name: get_src_root
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the source tree by locating 'src'.

methods.name: get_abs_path
methods.description: Converts a relative path (from src) to an absolute path.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes test stdout to update error files.
